crossingAngleFactor.source: LHC Design Report Vol. 1, Sec. 2.2, geometric luminosity reduction factor F for a 285 µrad crossing angle. Simplification: kept constant.

arcDispersionM.source: LHC Design Report Vol. 1, Ch. 3, peak horizontal dispersion in the arcs is about 2 m. Simplification: a single value for the whole ring.

apertureHalfWidthM.source: LHC Design Report Vol. 1, Ch. 5, beam screen half-height about 18 mm. Simplification: a single hard aperture with no beam-size margin.

rampRateGeVPerS.source: The LHC energy ramp from 450 GeV to 6.5 TeV takes about 20 minutes, https://home.cern/science/accelerators/large-hadron-collider. Simplification: constant rate once the start of the ramp is over.

maxRelativeRampRatePerS.source: The real ramp follows a parabolic-exponential-linear-parabolic (PELP) shape that starts slowly so the magnets and the RF can follow, LHC Design Report Vol. 1, Ch. 6. Simplification: the rate is capped at 0.3 % of the current energy per second.
